page_title: LEC 0-0 GEN | Lecce v Genoa 05/01/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' Livio Marinelli is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.
90+4' Frederic Guilbert (Lecce) wastes a big chance! He unleashes a shot from the edge of the box and it goes narrowly over the crossbar.
90+1' Lior Kasa (Genoa) receives a yellow card for a nasty tackle.
90' There will be a minimum of 4 min. of added time.
89' 9:4 – the corner kicks stats.
88' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Morten Thorsby walks off the pitch to be replaced by Patrizio Masini (Genoa).
86' The Lecce players are exchanging some short passes.
85' The resulting set piece from Lecce is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
84' A corner kick by Lecce is thwarted by the well prepared Nicola Leali (Genoa). The ball is out of play and Lecce manage to earn a corner.
84' Marco Giampaolo prepares a substitution. Nikola Krstovic is replaced by Ante Rebic (Lecce).
84' Substitution. Tete Morente did his best and is replaced by Jesper Karlsson (Lecce).
82' 3:1 – this is the current number of shots on target.
80' Lecce seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. Great movement by the offensive players allows the defenders to set up the attack.
78' The Lecce players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
75' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Lecce.
74' Lecce are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.
73' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Hamza Rafia departs the field of play to be replaced by Thorir Johann Helgason (Lecce).
73' Here is a change. Antonino Gallo is going off and Marco Giampaolo gives the last tactical orders to Santiago Pierotti (Lecce).
72' The corner is swung in but Genoa can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
71' Genoa have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
70' The manager has been forced to make a substitution and the injured Vitinha (Genoa) leaves the pitch to be replaced by Alessandro Zanoli.
70' The game is interrupted now, Vitinha (Genoa) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.

66' That didn't go as planned! Andrea Pinamonti (Genoa) tried his luck from the edge of the box, but his effort towards the bottom right corner was too weak to get past Wladimiro Falcone, who easily kept it out.
64' Here comes a substitution. Milan Badelj is given a rest as he is replaced by Lior Kasa (Genoa).
63' Genoa are showing great team chemistry. They are passing it around beautifully. Excellent team work.
60' The Genoa players are exchanging some short passes.
57' Lecce take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
57' Hamza Rafia (Lecce) steps up to take the corner, but the ball just sails in among the defenders. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Lecce.
56' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Lecce comes to nothing.

56' Patrick Dorgu (Lecce) does well to control a poor pass on the edge of the box then shoots towards the left side of the goal. Nicola Leali is out of position but leaps to make a brilliant save. Lecce win a corner.

55' Lecce slow the tempo of the game down by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult at the moment, very physically demanding to run without the ball.
53' Genoa are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.
51' Lecce take a short corner kick.
51' Antonino Gallo (Lecce) sends the ball into the box from the side of the pitch, but his cross is blocked. The ball is out of play. Lecce will have a chance to score from a corner.
49' Genoa can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
47' Lecce seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
46' Patrick Vieira makes a half-time substitution. Jeff Ekhator comes on in place of Fabio Miretti (Genoa).
46' The second half has just started.
45+1' The end of the first half.
44' Oh, what a chance! Andrea Pinamonti (Genoa) was quickest to the rebound but the ball hit the crossbar.
44' Morten Thorsby (Genoa) fires a shot from close range, but he is somehow only able to hit the crossbar!
43' Great teamplay by Genoa as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.

41' Long passes, short passes and one-two passes. Lecce are showcasing great team work by keeping possession and producing pin-point passes from player to player. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult to intercept at the moment.
38' Neat passing move from Lecce in order to create new attacking opportunities.
37' Nikola Krstovic (Lecce) is able to continue to play.
36' Nikola Krstovic (Lecce) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
34' Lecce control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
30' The percentage of ball possession is – 52:48.
27' The Lecce players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
25' Aaron Martin (Genoa) takes the corner kick and sends a lovely ball into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and knocks the ball to safety.

25' The Genoa players are exchanging fine passes and are waiting for an opportunity to start an attack, but here's a mistake and a loss of possession. The ball goes out of play and Lecce will have a goal kick.
22' Nikola Krstovic (Lecce) wastes a promising chance! He tries his luck with a shot from mid-range, but his effort hits the right post. A few inches to the left and it could have been a sweet goal!
21' Genoa enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
17' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Lecce.
14' Hamza Rafia (Lecce) swings in a cross from the corner, but Nicola Leali reads it well and gathers the ball.
13' Hamza Rafia (Lecce) takes the corner which is cleared by the opposition's defence. The referee blows his whistle, Lecce are awarded a corner kick.

13' Patrick Dorgu (Lecce) darts into the penalty area to latch on to a pass, and he unleashes a low shot in the direction of the right post. Nicola Leali is alert and denies him with a nice save. The linesman points to the corner flag, Lecce are going to take it.
11' Hamza Rafia (Lecce) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack.
9' Lecce exchange some quick one-two passes over a small area and control the game. Now they make a mistake and lose the ball and the whole situation changes in the blink of an eye.
5' The Genoa players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
2' The Lecce players are exchanging some short passes.
1' The first half has just begun.
